#.label: Checkout App: Infrastructure
#.description: Split proposal B: by topic. Holds a sub-object per touchpoint: pos, sco, mpos. Prototype: not registered in CCC, so it renders but cannot be saved. Proposed IAM role: checkout-infra-admin.
#/properties/pos.label: POS
#/properties/pos.description: Staffed till: the desktop Checkout App in POS mode.
#/properties/pos/properties/server.label: Server
#/properties/pos/properties/server/prope: The timeout for network calls. In milliseconds.
#/properties/pos/properties/edge.label: Edge
#/properties/pos/properties/edge/propert: This is a definition of the offline settings.

Enables offline integration. When enabled, losing connection to the Edge host will make the app switch to the offline local solution. Only works when the Edge host is configured. Not supported on mobile devices.
Edge host URL. Allows the application to switch to the Edge solution offline.
#/properties/pos/properties/connect/prop: Sets the connection mode for reading payment messages.
#/properties/pos/properties/autoUpdate/p: The channel for the update. Customers must use only the preview and stable channels - internal is reserved. All new updates will appear in the preview channel before being promoted to the stable channel. A preview channel will get preview and stable updates. A stable channel will get only stable updates. Customers are encouraged to setup a few tills on the preview channels to test drive new updates before being promoted to stable.

The maintenance exclusion window for the update. The exclusion maintenance period takes precedence over any scheduled maintenance window. Maximum of 30 days allowed. The exlusion window is applied only for stable channel and only for major and minor updates(semantic versioning).
The start date and time of the maintenance exclusion. Specify in the UTC time zone.
The number of days from the start date for the maintenance exclusion to take precedence. Maximum 30 days.

The maintenance window for the update. During this window the update will download and install automatically. To start update the app must be open else it will try to update on the next maintenance window. The maintenance window is applied to preview and stable channels for major, minor and patch updates(see semantic versioning)
Days of the week when maintenance updates can occur.
The start time of the maintenance window, e.g. 18:00:00. Specify in the UTC time zone.
The end time of the maintenance window, e.g. 23:59:00. Specify in the UTC time zone.
